General-content county map showing rural buildings and householders' names. Hand colored to emphasize town (township) boundaries and areas. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1855 by Robert Pearsall Smith in the ... Eastern District of Pennsylvania." LC copy imperfect: Brittle, originally printed on multiple sheets (later conjoined), fold-lined, sectioned to 6 panels to enable folding. Includes business directories, embellished border (Amerindian, farm animals), and illustrations of prominent buildings.
